result.summary: Found 1 significant accessibility issue in the promotional banner.

issues.description: The promotional banner uses white text on a very light mint background, creating extremely low contrast. Both the headline and checkout-code details are difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use a substantially darker text color or darken the banner background to meet WCAG contrast requirements (at least 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text).
